title: View of Punggol
provenance: Acquired by the estate of Tan Swee Lim in 1928, then sold to Wong Cheong's Art Dealership, Singapore in 1942. Later owned by the art collection of Joo Ming Siu before being consigned to Meridian Fine Arts Auctioneers, Singapore.
previous_owner: Collection of the late Dato' R. Sivanathan
